verdict.rationale: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API (and Anthropic Messages API) that any coding agent can point to as a backend, plus auto-detected function/tool-calling support and MCP integration for agentic tool use, directly enabling coding agents to use it as a backend. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation from a specific coding agent (e.g., Cursor/Continue) integration report beyond vendor docs.
